the subharmonic parametric excitation of the edge waves by the breaking surface waves is investigated in the laboratory.

the problem of parametrically induced subharmonic resonant generation of edge waves by surface waves propagating along a sloping bottom.

the problem of subharmonic resonant parametric excitation of internal waves by surface waves.
